title: Cost of a Goldreich–Levin stage step
statement: Let $n$ be a positive integer, let $a,b$ be positive integers with $2a\le b$, and let $M\ge1$ be an integer Fourier norm bound. For a Boolean target $f:\{\pm1\}^n\to\{\pm1\}$, a stage index $k<n$, a Goldreich–Levin query state, and a finite active family of coordinate subsets, running the stage-step program returns the state obtained by appending the stage’s estimate records and applying the prescribed state update. Its cost is the sum of the stage cost and the controller’s charged work for this dimension and threshold.
hypotheses_covered: Boolean target on the sign cube
